headline: Paradise Woods LLC's 150-unit residential development at 1795 Paradise Avenue was tabled.
summary: The application is special permit and site plan 26-1403 for 0 Old Coach Highway and 1795 Paradise Avenue, under Connecticut General Statute 8-30G. The item was tabled because of a pending de minimis from the Wetlands Officer and because the department is awaiting technical information. The applicant granted an extension, and the item will be re-noticed when it returns.
decisions: Tabled special permit and site plan 26-1403 for 150 units at 1795 Paradise Avenue and 0 Old Coach Highway.
discussion: Announcing tabling before a vote: One speaker said the commission cannot state that an item will be tabled until it actually happens, and asked why the board would ask it to break the rules.

Reason for tabling: The meeting said the item was tabled because of a pending de minimis from the Wetlands Officer and because the department was awaiting technical information. The applicant granted an extension.

decision_evidence.quote: I'll make a motion to table Special Revenue and Site Plan 2614. Is there a second? Second. All those in favor of tabling this item please say aye. Opposed? Abstentions? The item is tabled.

decision_titles: Special permit and site plan 26-1403, 1795 Paradise Avenue
